material_result: The unresolved 10-ms versus 1-ms convention is outcome-changing if eta_U/eta_D are implemented as per-step increments: in the bounded audit, dt=0.001 mean MSE was 0.01559 versus 0.32431 at dt=0.01, paired difference -0.30872 with bootstrap 95% CI [-0.31824,-0.29984]. With explicit dt-scaled learning updates, sensitivity was much smaller but still nonzero (0.46153 versus 0.55376). This does not reproduce the paper; it establishes that official-code resolution of timestep/update semantics is necessary before exact effect-size comparisons.
blocker: Official S1 Code ZIP bytes were not retrievable through the available public transports in this invocation; source-exact I(t), epsilon, initialization, update ordering and dt-scaling therefore remain unresolved.
